schema.description:
Which fields to return in the output. The lesser you return, the faster the output can be. Only request the fields that you actually need in your views.

**Status**

The `status` field is a cached field for ease of use. It is advised to call the status endpoint `/company/[id]/status` for the latest status of a company.

**Logos**

The `logos` field is a special field, as it will return a dictionary of logo fields. If you only need the logo filename, you can use `logo`.

**Contact**

The `contact` field is a special field, as it will return a dictionary of contact fields.

**ASNs***

If ASNs are configured for the company the `asns` field will return a list of ASN numbers.

**Indicators**

There are multi-level indicators possible, these will be presented as a "path-like" string, eg:

  - /animals/platypus
  - /animals/bird
  - etc.

It is advised to display these as grouped under their respective paths, eg:

```
  - Animals
    - Platypus
    - Bird
```

parameters.description: ISO8601, limits the results to start on this date, only works in conjunction with startdate. Enddate is inclusive. So selecting `2020-04-01T13:37:00+00:00` as enddate, will include all reports for that specific second as well. This could mean that the last bucket of a timeselection is always empty when it collides with a time bucket, eg, every 15 minutes. For example, given this period: `12:00:00 - 12:15:00`, will return 2 buckets: - 12:00:00 - 12:14:59 - 12:15:00 - 12:29:59 The contents of the buckets will be filtered on the given period, so the last bucket will only have the reports for the one second of the given period, which could give unexpected results. Instead, when using: `12:00:00 - 12:14:59`, only 1 bucket will be returned: - 12:00:00 - 12:14:59 - Be aware that the `+` in RFC3339 format needs to be urlencoded. - Be aware that the timezone is divided by a colon in ISO8601, eg: `2042-03-14T13:37:42+01:00`

schema.description:
Which fields to return in the output. The lesser you return, the faster the output can be. Only request the fields that you actually need in your views.

**Status**

The `status` field is a cached field for ease of use. It is advised to call the status endpoint `/company/[id]/status` for the latest status of a company.

**Logos**

The `logos` field is a special field, as it will return a dictionary of logo fields. If you only need the logo filename, you can use `logo`.

**Contact**

The `contact` field is a special field, as it will return a dictionary of contact fields.

**ASNs***

If ASNs are configured for the company the `asns` field will return a list of ASN numbers.

**Indicators**

There are multi-level indicators possible, these will be presented as a "path-like" string, eg:

  - /animals/platypus
  - /animals/bird
  - etc.

It is advised to display these as grouped under their respective paths, eg:

```
  - Animals
    - Platypus
    - Bird
```
